oil.when: 2005 (OIL LIFE message in the instrument panel display)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the key to RUN (the engine can be off or running).
Press the trip odometer reset stem once or twice until OIL LIFE shows and flashes in the display.
Press and hold the trip odometer button for a few seconds until the chime sounds five times.
OIL LIFE should now stay on without flashing. If the oil light comes back on and stays on for 30 seconds at the next key-on, repeat the steps.
